newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse trade with modest losses.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse trade with modest losses.

text.p: 1205 GMT - German shares end bourse trade with modest losses as DAX index fails to end session above key 3,800 point level. Traders expect stable dealings at slightly lower levels in post-bourse IBIS dealings. Wall Street to play key factor. But little movement expected before Tuesday's FOMC meeting.
* 30-share DAX down 9.64 points at 3,785.77 points. IBIS DAX down 15.45 points at 3,794.47 points.
* September DAX futures down 10.0 points at 3,823.0 points.
* Chemical shares higher at end of bourse, with Bayer, Hoechst and BASF all posting gains.
* Siemens down on profit-taking after advance.
